_doc: Pre-authorised losses (PLAN §1 clause 4), written by hand from the specs. A conversion report's loss entry is allowed only if a rule below matches (kind, source version, target version, category). 'category' is matched exactly or, when it ends in ':*', as a prefix. Version bounds are inclusive; 'when' adds a condition the checker evaluates (tests/independent/allowed.py). The cell matrix (docs/CONVERSION_MATRIX.md) is generated from these rules.

systems._doc: Satellite systems each version's observation files define (rinex210.txt §3/Table A1: G R S T; rinex211.txt §10.1.3: + E; rinex301.txt p.8: + C; rinex302.txt: + J; rinex303.txt: + I). Transit (T) was removed in 2.11.
